$comment: WO035-1 — promote 6 retargeted cls-dialog rows to the React canvas editor: page-setup margins/size/custom-size (Layout Page Setup buttons -> world-office:page-layout), columns (Layout Columns -> world-office:columns), watermark (Layout Watermark -> image right rail), bookmark (References Captions Bookmark -> crossreference right rail). Legacy dialog-input specs in di-page.json/di-ref-review.json targeted the retired vanilla bundle (#ps-mt/#columns-count/#wm-text/#bookmark-name DOM); the React editor has no dialogs for these — the ported surfaces are the ribbon buttons' world-office:* engine events and the right-panel rails they open.

dialoginput.page-setup-margins.note: WO035-1 react-port: legacy Page-setup-dialog margins branch (#ps-mt/#ps-mr + Apply -> .page-setup twips marker) has no dialog in the React editor; the Layout > Page Setup > Margins button (#btn-page-margins, command pageMargins) dispatches world-office:page-layout (word-commands.ts case pageMargins: detail.margins from documentStore) which Viewport applies as margin CSS — the ported observable for the margins branch.

dialoginput.page-setup-size.note: WO035-1 react-port: legacy Page-setup-dialog size branch (#ps-size Legal + #ps-mb -> .page-setup twips marker) maps to the Layout > Page Setup > Size button (#btn-page-size, command pageSize) which dispatches world-office:page-layout (word-commands.ts case pageSize: detail.pageSize) — Viewport re-renders the page at the new size; the dialog itself does not exist in the React editor.

dialoginput.page-setup-custom-size.note: WO035-1 react-port: the legacy ps-size==='custom' branch (rememberCustomSize + dialog w/h -> 11906x16838 marker) has NO dedicated control in the React editor — closest ported surface is the same Size button (#btn-page-size -> pageSize -> world-office:page-layout, store pageSize A4/A3/Letter/Legal); divergence noted, the custom WxH input is not implemented in the canvas editor.

dialoginput.columns-count-gap.note: WO035-1 react-port: legacy Columns dialog (#columns-count=4/#columns-gap=80 -> <section data-columns data-column-gap>) maps to the Layout > Page Setup > Columns button (#btn-columns, command columns) which dispatches world-office:columns {count:2} (word-commands.ts case columns, clamped 1-3) — Viewport applies columnCount/columnGap CSS; the count+gap dialog does not exist in the React editor.

dialoginput.watermark-custom-text.note: WO035-1 react-port: legacy Watermark dialog (wm-mode=custom/#wm-text/#wm-color -> div.watermark marker) maps to the Layout > Page Background > Watermark button (#btn-watermark, command watermark) which opens the page-background rail — toggleRightPanel('image') renders [data-wo-right-panel="image"] with the ImagePanel (word-commands.ts case watermark, grouped with pageColor/documentColors); the custom-text dialog does not exist in the React editor.

dialoginput.bookmark.note: WO035-1 react-port: legacy Bookmark dialog (#bookmark-name + Insert -> span at the caret) maps to the References > Captions > Bookmark button (#btn-insert-bookmark, command insertBookmark) which opens the cross-reference rail — toggleRightPanel('crossreference') renders [data-wo-right-panel="crossreference"] with the CrossReferencePanel (word-commands.ts reference-command group); the name-input dialog does not exist in the React editor.
